title: Creative Content Lead
description:
Creative Content Lead
35,000 - 40,000, Haywards Heath, Monday to Friday, full-time, permanent, 20 days holiday rising with service, HealthShield cash plan, wellbeing benefits, staff discount, company events

The Role
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Content & Creative Lead to join an established premium consumer brand in Haywards Heath. Working as part of the wider marketing and creative function and reporting to the Head of Retail, this is a hands-on position for someone who loves turning creative ideas into beautiful, commercially effective content. You will take ownership of day-to-day creative output across digital, paid media and print, while helping ensure every customer touchpoint reflects the quality and aspirational feel of the brand.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Create high-quality digital and static content for paid advertising campaigns across platforms including Meta and Google Performance Max
- Develop creative concepts and turn ideas into engaging, on-brand campaign assets
- Review paid media performance to understand which creative concepts are working and use these insights to continually improve future content
- Produce and manage digital and print assets including magazine advertising, point-of-sale materials and other above-the-line campaigns
- Support the planning and production of direct mail campaigns, considering audience, product focus, messaging and storytelling
- Coordinate photoshoots and content capture, ensuring post-shoot assets are edited and ready for use across relevant channels
- Edit video content and support the development of engaging video creative, where experience allows
- Use AI tools appropriately to increase creative output, develop variations and support planning and analysis
- Act as a guardian of the brand's visual identity, maintaining brand guidelines and ensuring content feels consistent across every customer touchpoint
- Work with external agencies, media partners and suppliers to ensure creative is delivered effectively and to deadline
- Support and develop a Junior Graphic Designer, helping to prioritise workload and maximise the creative resource available within the team
- Research emerging creative opportunities and channels, helping the brand explore areas such as TikTok, AI advertising and future media opportunities

Requirements
Previous experience within a hands-on creative, graphic design or content role is necessary, ideally with around three years or more experience in a commercially focused environment. Strong graphic design skills and proficiency with Adobe InDesign are highly desirable, alongside the ability to confidently create professional assets beyond template-led platforms such as Canva. Experience creating static content for paid advertising and an understanding of how creative can influence campaign performance would also be highly desirable.

You will be an ideas-driven and proactive creative who enjoys implementing your work rather than solely developing strategy. Experience within a premium, luxury, aspirational or high-consideration consumer environment would be desirable, although applications from other sectors with an appropriate creative style are welcomed. Video editing, shoot production, AI creative tools and previous mentoring or management experience would be advantageous but are not essential.

This role could suit someone who has worked as a Senior Graphic Designer, Senior Creative Designer or Creative Content Manager.

Company Information
Our client is an established and highly regarded premium consumer brand with a strong emphasis on beautiful design, aspirational content and an exceptional customer experience. The business has built a distinctive visual identity and places creativity at the heart of how it communicates with its customers.

You will join a collaborative marketing and creative environment where ideas are encouraged and where the Content & Creative Lead will have the opportunity to influence how the brand evolves across established and emerging channels. This is particularly well suited to someone who wants creative ownership while remaining close to the hands-on design and production work they enjoy.

Package
- 35,000 - 40,000 salary
- Permanent position
- Monday to Friday
- 20 days' annual leave, increasing with length of service
- HealthShield cash plan
- Gym and wellbeing credits
- Staff discount
- Summer and Christmas company events
- Family-friendly approach
- Accessible Haywards Heath location with public transport links
- Nearby parking options

Travail Employment Group is operating as an Employment Agency. Once you click to apply for this job your application will be immediately received by Travail Employment Group. If your application is successful a consultant will be in contact with you within the next 7 days. If you do not hear within 7 days you have unfortunately not been successful on this occasion.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing & Communications Executive
- Location: Burgess Hill, Head Office
- Job Type: Full-time, 40 hours per week
- Working Pattern: Office-based
- Salary: £32,000

We're currently supporting a client in their search for a Marketing & Communications Executive to join their growing team. Working closely with senior leadership, this position plays a key role in delivering marketing initiatives and supporting wider business growth.

The successful candidate will be involved in creating engaging content, managing digital marketing activities, and supporting commercial objectives through effective communication, creative campaigns, and brand-focused marketing efforts. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their marketing career within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Support the delivery of the marketing strategy, ensuring consistent branding and tone of voice across all communications.
- Manage and create content for social media channels, keeping the website content fresh and optimised for SEO.
- Develop written, visual, and video content for digital channels, newsletters, case studies, and customer communications.
- Create and adapt marketing and sales collateral using Adobe Creative Suite.
- Support exhibitions, events, and sales activities with relevant communications and marketing materials.
- Maintain marketing activity calendars and assist with updates to the eCommerce site.
- Keep CRM and marketing data accurate and up-to-date.
- Monitor marketing activity and performance, identifying opportunities for improvement.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across the business to identify content and marketing opportunities.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Minimum 18 months experience in a marketing or communications role.
- Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, CRM systems, CMS, and Google Analytics.
- Skilled in creating and editing video and visual content.
- Creative with a keen eye for design and visual communication.
- Strong writing skills and confident in communication.
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
- Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
- Experienced in using AI tools to support research, content creation, idea generation, editing, productivity, and marketing effectiveness.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and performance-related incentives.
- Opportunities for professional development and training.
- Dynamic work environment with a focus on innovation and creativity.
- Participation in industry events and exhibitions.

If you are interested, please apply as soon as possible.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced marketer to take ownership of a well-established consumer brand, leading integrated campaigns across brand, digital, media and product launches. Working closely with senior stakeholders, you'll drive commercial growth, strengthen brand positioning, and shape marketing strategy within a growing business.

A growing multi-brand business with a strong customer focus, operating across both retail and eCommerce channels. The company offers a collaborative, fast-paced environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and play a key role in driving future growth.

Description
- Develop and deliver brand-focused marketing plans that support commercial growth
- Lead integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, content, email and offline channels
- Drive brand awareness, customer engagement and lead generation activities
- Manage product launches and go-to-market campaigns from planning through to execution
- Own brand messaging, positioning and creative consistency across all customer touchpoints
- Monitor campaign performance, analyse results and optimise activity to maximise ROI
- Manage marketing budgets and ensure effective allocation of spend
- Oversee website content and customer journey improvements to enhance performance
- Work closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies to deliver campaigns
- Identify market trends, customer insights and new opportunities for growth
- Produce regular performance reports and recommendations for senior stakeholders

Profile
- Proven experience in brand and digital marketing
- Strong campaign planning and execution skills
- Commercially minded with budget and ROI experience
- Skilled in stakeholder and agency management
- Confident using data and insights to drive decisions
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Highly organised and able to manage multiple projects
- Experience within retail, ecommerce or consumer brands

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive - PPC & Analytics
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Digital Marketing Executive to join a growing digital agency, managing paid media campaigns and performance tracking across a varied portfolio of SME clients.

This is a delivery-focused role with a particular emphasis on Google Search Ads and conversion tracking. You'll take ownership of existing client accounts, manage and optimise campaigns, and ensure the tracking behind them is set up accurately.

You'll also work across Meta Ads and wider digital marketing activity, collaborating with SEO, content and web development colleagues.

Key responsibilities
- Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns, with a strong focus on Search.
- Audit existing PPC accounts and identify opportunities to improve performance.
- Manage keywords, search terms, negative keywords, bidding strategies, budgets and ad copy.
- Monitor campaign performance against CPA, conversions, ROAS and wider client objectives.
- Set up and manage conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager and GA4.
- Configure tags, triggers, events and conversions across client websites and campaigns.
- Troubleshoot tracking issues and ensure conversion data is accurate and reliable.
- Manage and optimise Meta Ads campaigns.
- Produce clear performance reporting and translate data into practical recommendations for clients.
- Support landing-page optimisation, CRO and A/B testing.
- Work directly with clients to discuss campaign performance, strategy and improvements.
- Collaborate with SEO, content and web development teams across wider client projects.

What we're looking for
- Strong hands-on experience managing Google Ads/Search campaigns.
- Practical experience with Google Tag Manager and GA4, including setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking.
- Experience managing paid media budgets and optimising against commercial KPIs.
- Hands-on Meta Ads experience.
- Good understanding of digital analytics, attribution and conversion measurement.
- Comfortable managing multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn performance data into recommendations.
- Confident communicating directly with clients.
- Agency or multi-client experience would be particularly beneficial.

Desirable experience
- Looker Studio/reporting dashboards.
- SEO and content optimisation.
- CRO and landing-page optimisation.
- Google Shopping, Performance Max, Display or Merchant Centre.
- Ecommerce campaigns.
- Marketing automation and AI tools.

This would suit someone who enjoys being hands-on with campaigns and data, rather than moving away from delivery into pure strategy or management. You'll have autonomy over your accounts and the opportunity to work across a varied client base while continuing to develop your wider digital marketing expertise.

title: SEO Manager
description:
KRG are working with a long established and highly respected integrated marketing agency in Brighton who are on the search for an SEO Manager to join their growing team. They work on integrated campaigns for a range of local and UK clients using their specialists across SEO, content, social media, paid media, web design and analytics.

The team has been expanding over the past few months as the agency has had a increase of inbound leads with new clients and they value ensuring that none of the team have a workload which is too much, so they're looking to hire another Manager to own some of their growing client accounts!

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute SEO strategies tailored to clients' goals and target audiences.
- Conduct keyword research to identify opportunities for content and technical optimisation.
- Perform SEO audits of client websites to assess performance, uncover issues, and recommend improvements.
- Manage on-page SEO including meta tags, internal linking, URL structure, content optimisation, and schema markup.
- Oversee technical SEO such as site speed, mobile-friendliness, crawlability, indexing, and structured data.
- Collaborate with content teams to guide the creation of SEO-optimised content (blogs, landing pages, etc.).
- Monitor and analyse SEO performance using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, etc.
- Generate reports that clearly communicate SEO progress, KPIs, and ROI to clients.
- Stay up to date with industry trends, algorithm updates, and best practices.
- Coordinate with web developers to implement technical changes and enhancements.
- Communicate with clients regularly to provide updates, present results, and refine strategy.
- Support junior team members, ensuring best practices are followed across client accounts.
- Maintain project timelines and budgets while ensuring deliverables meet quality standards.

About You:
- Agency side SEO experience at a Senior Executive or Manager level - or equivalent.
- Good organisation and time management skills.
- Analytical mind and problem-solving skills.
- Great written skills.
- Proficiency in Google Docs, Sheets and Slides.
- Understanding of CSS and HTML.
- Basic understanding/interest in AI.

What can they offer you?
- The agency is focusing on expanding their already established SEO team with three new hires in the past 6 months - everybody across the agency sees the value in SEO and wants the team to do well!
- A vibrant and creative environment in the heart of Brighton.
- 28 days holiday, plus bank holidays.
- Christmas office closure.
- Hybrid working model.
- Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and sick pay
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) supporting health and wellbeing
- Scottish Widows pension
- Personal Development Plan with biannual reviews and objective setting
- Annual pay review
- Unparalleled training and development opportunities.
- Regular employee training sessions and team-building activities
- Referral Bonus for introducing new employees
- Regular company socials
- Christmas and Summer company parties
- Amazon voucher on your birthday
- Local artisan coffee, weekly fruit delivery, cakes and treats
- Modern and creative office space with break-out areas, including pool, ping pong table and darts.

title: Telemarketing Campaign Executive
description:
Telemarketing Campaign Executive
Chichester
Office Based Permanent - Full / Part Time hours available

Are you a confident communicator who enjoys building relationships and creating meaningful conversations? Have you worked in telemarketing or would like to and keen to learn? If so, we are recruiting for a Campaign Executive to join a growing and supportive telemarketing business that helps businesses connect with key decision-makers through high-quality engagement.

This Campaign Executive role is perfect for someone who is motivated to reach achievable targets, understanding a client s needs and expectations, nurturing professional relationships to build a pipeline for future sales growth, and delivering an exceptional client experience.

Working across a range of B2 B campaigns, you'll engage with prospective customers, identify opportunities, and help clients develop strong sales pipelines through thoughtful, consultative conversations.

As a Campaign Executive, you'll become a trusted first point of contact, representing clients professionally while building long-term engagement that creates real business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities
- Build rapport with prospective customers through professional outbound conversations
- Information find and develop and nurture relationships with key decision-makers across multiple sectors
- Qualify opportunities and arrange meetings for clients' sales teams
- Manage and update CRM records, ensuring accurate campaign data
- Understand customer needs, buying processes and future opportunities
- Collaborate with colleagues to improve campaign performance
- Maintain regular follow-up activity to keep prospects engaged
- Deliver a positive customer experience on every interaction

9am 5pm Monday to Friday. Full and part time hours are available

Salary
£26,000

Benefits
